change: No changes. Primary (Quads all 3 vasti, Gluteus Maximus+Medius, Adductors) and secondary (Hamstrings, obliques, Calves full) are correct for a lateral squat on unstable balance board surface. Calves/Soleus appropriate for ankle stabilization on balance board.

No changes. Quads + Glutes as primary, Hamstrings + obliques (anti-rotation for unilateral hold) + Erector Spinae as secondary are all appropriate for this asymmetric squat variant with medicine ball held to one side.

Quads secondary: added Vastus Medialis to complete the full quadriceps group (Rectus Femoris + Vastus Medialis + Vastus Lateralis). Squat-to-pick-up phase engages all three quad heads. Original was missing Vastus Medialis.
Added Lats->Rotator Cuff as a secondary entry. Per CLAUDE.md rules, all pull exercises require Rotator Cuff as secondary stabilizer. Original was missing this mandatory entry.

1) trackingMode changed from '' to 'repsOnly': bicycle crunch is a counted-rep bodyweight-style movement; no external load weight is tracked even with band resistance. 2) Secondary hip flexors changed from Quads->Rectus Femoris to Abductor->Abductor: hip flexors (iliopsoas) map to the Abductor bucket per CLAUDE.md. Rectus Femoris was an incorrect bucket mapping for the hip flexor role here.
